thread:
sara_support: FYI — Acme (prod) opened a support ticket: after today's canary roll their integration webhooks are either receiving no tool call or a tool_call whose args are double-escaped as a string. Blocking billing emails. Can someone take a look?

mike_acme: Repro from our side (simplified):
```
Request -> Redwood API: { "input": "please send invoice", "tool_call": true }
Response -> assistant: {"tool_call": "{\"name\":\"send_email\",\"args\":\"{\\\"to\\\":\\\"billing@acme.com\\\",\\\"body\\\":\\\"Invoice attached\\\"}\"}" }
```

mike_acme: Sometimes the assistant returns no tool_call at all and the customer flow falls back to manual handling. Started after 09:12 canary.

alex_oncall: Which rollout/tag exactly? Any correlation id from the failed requests?

mike_acme: Canary tag: canary-2026-04-12-0910. Sample request id: rid_8f3b2c. Sent logs to support with that rid.

deploy-bot: Deploy canary-2026-04-12-0910 -> runtime-service v2.4.0, model router v1.9.1

alex_oncall: Thanks — looks like runtime bumped to v2.4.0 in that canary. We saw a serialization change in the runtime layer for toolcall payloads in that release candidate. Quick hypothesis: the tool call args are being stringified twice before being returned to the user-facing layer, so webhooks receive a string containing JSON rather than structured JSON.

jess_product: Any config flags that could flip serialization behavior (legacy vs new structured toolcall)? Would like a short-term mitigation customers can apply.

alex_oncall: Short-term options: 1) Recommend customer add idempotent parsing in their webhook to attempt JSON.parse if args is a string. 2) Roll back canary to runtime v2.3.4 if they need immediate fix. Long-term: patch in runtime to stop double-escaping — patch candidate prepared, needs QA.

mike_acme: We can add parsing as a temporary workaround but that changes our contract. Can you prioritize a patch and hotfix? This is affecting >50 invoices/hour.

alex_oncall: Understood. Escalating to eng-runtime with priority P0. Attaching reproducer, request ids, and a minimal test harness. Will report back with ETA.

sara_support: I sent the customer the workaround and the rollback option. Marking as escalated.

jess_product: Please keep product in the loop on rollout guardrails — we should add an automated smoke test for toolcall shapes during canary gating.

alex_oncall: Agreed. I'll add a canary check to the CI pipeline to validate toolcall payloads and prevent this from slipping through again.

mike_acme: Thanks — waiting on hotfix. :pray:
